name: Unidentified B1-series battle droid (Gabredor III)
description: A B1-series battle droid helped governor Tauntaza to escape from her secret base on the planet Gabredor III. The droid was destroyed till he tried to stop Vader.

data.name: Unidentified B1-series battle droid
data.death: Between 3 ABY and 4 ABY, Gabredor III
